name: Sequester

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: gem dust worth 5,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

targets.description: an object or a willing creature you touch

summary: Hide an object or willing creature: it's Invisible and hidden from divination, and a creature sleeps without aging.
text: A sequestered creature is Unconscious and needs no food, water or air. You can set an ending condition that happens within 1 mile of the target, and the spell also ends if the target takes damage.
